task.title: Invoke compiled tools in fresh resource-limited stores
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/625 by adapting one inert compiled component to the existing authorized kernel Tool contract.
acceptance_criteria: Expose inert exact-ID pure-effect metadata and run guest code only through authorized invocation.
Create a fresh no-import store and instance for every invocation without reusable guest state.
Round-trip exact JSON and fail closed on guest errors, malformed output, traps, and setup failures.
Enforce explicit memory, table, instance, fuel, and epoch limits without retry or persistence.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for component-backed tool invocation.
attempts.diagnostic: The crate had no ComponentTool adapter, invocation error taxonomy, or explicit resource-policy type.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests for inert metadata, JSON behavior, guest failures, fresh state, and each configured resource limit.

attempts.diagnostic: One store and instance per authorized call prevents guest state from becoming an implicit grant or cross-invocation channel.
attempts.patch: Added ComponentTool, ToolExecutionLimits, no-import instantiation, exact JSON conversion, and sourced typed invocation failures.

attempts.summary: Applied bounded execution without broadening capabilities.
attempts.diagnostic: Resource exhaustion and traps must terminate one invocation without retry while a shared epoch ticker must not let one call shorten another deadline.
attempts.patch: Added store resource limits, fuel, a shared ticker with per-store epoch deadlines, documented defaults, and termination coverage.

outcome.summary: Compiled version 0.1.0 tools now execute only after caller-owned authorization in fresh no-import stores with explicit deterministic resource limits.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --test component_tool --offline
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30210322084 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/626

lessons: Fresh stores make guest state isolation explicit and deterministic.
Inert metadata access preserves the existing authorization-before-execution ordering.
Guest success still requires host-side JSON validation before a value crosses the adapter boundary.
Fuel, epoch, and store limits are invocation policy rather than part of the guest ABI.
